steps.title: Model call 1 for rational capital allocation: 2,464 tokens in, 210 out, ~$0.0009 at paid rates
details: The model decided to submit its finding: evidence found, citing passage 7:63 sentence 1; passage 7:16 sentence 4; passage 7:6 sentences 4 to 8.

details: Verdict: evidence found.

The quoted text below was built by code from the cited sentences.
steps.quote:
Our Strategy is aligned with the Company's capital allocation philosophy of: (i) invest in opportunities to grow the business and drive strong returns, including both capital expenditures as well as investments in technology, digital, and our GBS organization, (ii) prioritize our dividend and (iii) repurchase shares with remaining free cash flow over time. … •Capital expenditures of $3.4 billion were mainly allocated to new restaurant openings and, to a lesser extent, to reinvestment in existing restaurants.
•Free cash flow was $7.2 billion, an 8% increase from the prior year.
•Across the System, nearly 2,300 new restaurants (including those in our developmental licensee and affiliated markets) were opened.
•The Company increased its quarterly cash dividend per share by 5% to $1.86 for the fourth quarter, equivalent to an annual dividend of $7.44 per share. The Company returned a total of $7.1 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases in 2025.
